steps.content: On an empty counter in the Tuco Palace lies a note. Seems like someone wrote it and placed it there in secret.

Tuco's food sucks and the weather's crap, but for some reason, I quite like it here. Maybe... it's because it reminds me of the old Syndicate?

The wind, the car races, and the sand that gets into your mouth from all the laughter...
Dazzle everyone with a mind-blowing hero's entrance!

Thinking about it now, those lines are pretty cool... of course, that swindler Korryn probably just made them up on the spot!

Though I only spent three days here, I learned a ton of stuff I'd never even heard of—mostly shady tricks, but some are quite useful.

For example, the yummiest part of a sandworm, or how to stroke sand foxes so they don't freak out... It might be useless trivia I'll never use, but who knows, right?!

Anyway, thanks a lot, guys! See you around!
